name: Web Developer
description: Constructs modern, responsive, and performant web applications using modern client-side and server-side technologies.

HTML: Semantic HTML5 Markup and Content Structure
Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) & ARIA Roles
Form Validation and Modern Media Embeds
CSS: Flexible Box (Flexbox) and Two-Dimensional CSS Grid
Keyframe Animations, Smooth Transitions, and Transforms
JavaScript: DOM Traversal, Event Delegation, and Mutation
React: Functional Components and Hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo)
State Management and Lifting State Up
Component Lifecycle, Virtual DOM, and Re-rendering Optimization
Responsive Design: Mobile-First Media Queries and Fluid Typography
Flexible Images and Viewport Units (vw, vh, rem)
Git: Resolving Merge Conflicts Cleanly in Pull Requests
REST APIs: Data Fetching with Fetch API and Axios
Handling Async State Transitions (Loading, Error, Success)
Client-Side Request Caching and Data Formatting
TypeScript: Type Annotations, Primitive Types, and Unions
Typing React Props, State, and Event Handlers
Node.js: Express Server Setup and Middleware Pipelines
Node.js Event Loop and Non-Blocking File I/O
RESTful Endpoint Controllers and Request Validation
Next.js: Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Incremental Static Regeneration
File-System Routing and API Route Handlers
Tailwind CSS: Utility-First Styling Workflow and JIT Compiler
Responsive Modifiers and State Variants (hover, focus)
Web Performance: Core Web Vitals Optimization (LCP, INP, CLS)
Code Splitting, Dynamic Imports, and Lazy Loading
Asset Minification, Compression, and Browser Caching
